rationale: The agent executed multiple order-changing writes (address update, item exchange, and order cancellation) without first confirming each action with the user. There is no evidence of user authentication beyond an email lookup; policy requires authenticating the user before acting. While the agent did retrieve order details, there’s no explicit verification that the orders belonged to the user. The agent also appeared to proceed with an item exchange involving a specific payment method without confirming any potential charges or differences. The final message is generic and does not provide clear, correct final information about what was changed. These gaps violate the stated policy, so the conversation fails the pass bar.
